basic_info.name: AllMusicCaps (companion model often read as 'am-CLAP' / MTG-improved CLAP) — improved Music CLAP model trained with AllMusicCaps album-review captions + SigReg regularization
basic_info.org: Pablo Alonso-Jiménez, Xavier Lizarraga-Seijas, Xavier Serra, Dmitry Bogdanov — Music Technology Group (MTG), Universitat Pompeu Fabra, Barcelona
basic_info.links: paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25244 ; code: https://github.com/MTG/allmusiccaps ; pip package: https://pypi.org/project/amclap/ ; caption dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mtg-upf/allmusiccaps ; model checkpoints (12 variants): https://huggingface.co/mtg-upf/allmusiccaps_baseline ... allmusiccaps_te_trained_sigreg (best)

architecture.backbone: Music CLAP with OMAR-RQ audio encoder + all-mpnet-base-v2 sentence-transformer text encoder (frozen at baseline; also trained-text-encoder variants separated); SigReg regularization (isotropic-Gaussian embedding objective, in spirit of LeJEPA) applied to embedding space
architecture.training_objective: InfoNCE contrastive (baseline recipe) with complementary human-written supervision; ablations include sigmoid loss, LeJEPA-style cosine objective, InfoNCE+SigReg, and trained vs frozen text encoder. Best overall model: te_trained_sigreg (InfoNCE + SigReg + trained text encoder); most parseable frozen-TE recipe: all_layers (contrastive across all encoder layers). SigReg improves MLP probing and text-to-music retrieval
architecture.embedding_output: Global CLAP-style embedding (single vector per clip); embedding dimension equal to all-mpnet-base-v2 output, 768-d [uncertain — not explicitly verified]; no frame-level embeddings [uncertain]

data.training_data: AllMusicCaps caption dataset: 540,454 rows pairing YouTube tracks with captions derived from professional AllMusic album reviews (paper abstract states caption corpus of 24,5346 [sic, likely 245,346] LLM-processed samples; HF dataset card says 540,454 rows incl. two caption styles: review 'quotes' and LLM-filled 'structured' attributes). LLM pipeline extracts descriptive musical quotes from noisy expert reviews and rewrites them into training-ready captions; v0 (repro) and v1 (normalized) releases; captions only, no audio. Combined with a baseline tag-derived caption dataset (baseline_quotes: baseline + review captions). Data released publicly; audio not redistributed

performance.benchmarks: Embedding-family, music-language: text-to-music retrieval on Song Describer (human-written captions) — largest gains from album-review supervision, particularly on complex queries other caption datasets leave uncovered [exact R@K numbers not extracted from paper yet — uncertain]; zero-shot classification; MLP probing across classification tasks (SigReg improves probing); outperforms open CLAP-style baselines on text-to-music retrieval, zero-shot classification, and most MLP probing tasks
performance.vs_clap: Outperforms open CLAP baselines across text-to-music retrieval, zero-shot classification and most MLP probing tasks; specific deltas vs LAION-CLAP / MusicCapsCLAP not extracted [uncertain]

availability.license: Caption dataset on HF (mtg-upf/allmusiccaps; transcription-derived YouTube audio not redistributed); 12 model checkpoints public incl. best te_trained_sigreg; pip install amclap gives CPU inference; code/data license terms not fully extracted [uncertain — MAEC-style releases at MTG are typically CC-BY for data]

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: OMAR-RQ audio encoder sample rate not stated in extracted material; MTG CLAP-family models typically 16 kHz [uncertain] — resampling from repo-standard 48 kHz required
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: CPU inference explicitly supported (pip amclap, get_model(device='cpu')); compact CLAP-family stack (small text encoder + OMAR-RQ audio encoder), per-track latency not published [uncertain]; SigReg training extra needs LeJEPA from git but inference needs nothing extra
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: CLAP-style fixed-clip encoding; OMAR-style encoders are typically windowed [uncertain]; no long-context support stated
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: No — global clip-level alignment only; frame-level supervision not part of the recipe
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: No attribute-conditioned steering; album-review captions give rich taste/scene phrasing (evaluative adjectives, narrative scene framing) which improves natural-language query diversity coverage — plain cosine retrieval only

uncertain: Song Describer exact R@K numbers (abstract claims gains, table not extracted)
Exact caption-corpus count ambiguity: 245,346 (abstract typo '24,5346') vs 540,454 dataset rows
SigReg frame-level support absent — global-only assumed
